injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.comment: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.comment: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.comment: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.comment: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Moussa Diabate
injuries.comment: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

injuries.name: Brandon Miller
injuries.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Miller (groin) will be re-evaluated over the weekend, and they expect to have more information by Monday, Steve Reed of The Associated Press reports.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.comment: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.comment: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.comment: Powell (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.comment: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.comment: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.comment: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Zach Collins
injuries.comment: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.comment: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.comment: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jarrett Allen
injuries.comment: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Jackson
injuries.comment: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.comment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Luka Doncic
injuries.comment: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.comment: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.comment: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Joan Beringer
injuries.comment: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.comment: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Desmond Bane
injuries.comment: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.comment: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.comment: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.comment: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jordan Goodwin
injuries.comment: Goodwin (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries.name: Robert Williams III
injuries.comment: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.comment: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.comment: Barnes (adductor) is listed as out for Friday's game against Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Immanuel Quickley
injuries.comment: Quickley (hamstring) won't play Friday in Milwaukee, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.comment: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.comment: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Deandre Ayton
injuries.comment: Ayton won't return to Saturday's game against the Thunder due to a lower leg injury.

injuries.name: Anthony Davis
injuries.comment: Davis (ankle) won't play Saturday against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.comment: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
